title: Closure under randomized reductions
statement: Let $B$ and $C$ be languages of bit strings. If $B$ is randomized reducible to $C$ and $C$ belongs to the bounded-error class defined by the specified polynomial-time verifier model, then $B$ belongs to that class as well.
hypotheses_covered: Membership of $C$ in the bounded-error class for the specified polynomial-time verifier model
